A must-have verifiably failed, or fit below 40 with assessable ≥ 60%
Fit ≥ 70, sufficiency ≥ 80%, no material claim contradicted or conflicting

policy.company_type_rule: Startup if founded within 10 years and (≤ 500 employees or last round seed to Series C); otherwise established
policy.investor_ranking_rule: Σ 0.5^(years since round / 2) over dated, named comparable rounds in the last 6 years
policy.comparables_rule: Same top industry, same HQ country, headcount within ×0.5–×2
